description: (0.5.0) An inclusion proof cannot be checked without a receipt that verified (RFC-ACDP-0012 §9.1 step 1 and the (0.5.0) 'Precondition: a verified receipt'). The log verdict is then log_inclusion: cannot_verify — never logged, never invalid_log_proof, and the echoed leaf is never trusted.

input.proof: The log-001 inclusion proof and checkpoint, served with the matching body

expected.behavior: The receipt failure is reported in its own verdict.

scenarios.name: C — echoed leaf matches the true leaf, no receipt
D — as A, under a require-inclusion policy

expected.behavior: Fails closed, attributed to the receipt, never invalid_log_proof.

notes: Behavioral; not executed by scripts/conformance-runner.py (no registry_test_keypair). cannot_verify is a report value, not a wire error code.
